title: Bellroot and Veyrhold presentation cues
summary: A compact production-feel layer for the first-town release path. These cues use approved runtime sheets only and stage VFX/audio intent without adding autoplay audio, new routes, or unapproved external assets.
operatorRules: Use approved runtime art sheets only.
Do not surface rejected prologue glyph sheets as production art.
Audio entries describe future mix intent only; no browser autoplay or external dependency is added.
Every cue must include a calm reduced-motion alternative.
Keep the cues inside the existing /hq drawers and first-town flow.

cues.label: Bellroot Vestibule witness tone
cues.ambientCopy: Warm oath lamps, bronze root-bells, and low witness tension should lead the opening before combat unlocks.
cues.vfxIntent: Soft amber motes and slow lamp shimmer around story buttons.
cues.audioIntent: Low bell resonance, glass chime ticks, and quiet room tone for a non-combat opening.
cues.reducedMotionAlternative: Static amber vignette, no pulsing lamp bloom, and one still VFX icon.
cues.uiProof: Adventure drawer intro and story card

cues.label: Warden's Antechamber first ward
cues.ambientCopy: The first fight should feel like an oath trial: brass pressure, careful sparks, and readable danger.
cues.vfxIntent: Low-flash hit sparks, shield flares, and a short loot glint after the first ward falls.
cues.audioIntent: Muted metal impact, breathy ward hum, and a short combat sting once blades are allowed.
cues.reducedMotionAlternative: Single-frame hit flash with no screen shake and no looping spark trail.

cues.label: Veyrhold hearth arrival
cues.ambientCopy: Veyrhold should read as the first safe civic hub: hearth towers, route relief, and practical gear prep.
cues.vfxIntent: Small arrival glints on town chips and a restrained route-complete glow.
cues.audioIntent: Distant bells, market cloth, forge air, and a calm arrival cadence.
cues.reducedMotionAlternative: Static town card treatment with no travel glow sweep.

cues.label: Oathmarket civic trade
cues.ambientCopy: Starter wares should feel grounded: city-scrip, worn brass counters, and useful first accessories.
cues.vfxIntent: Tiny coin glints and quality-frame accents on trade choices.
cues.audioIntent: Coin cloth, ledger paper, and a soft confirmation tick for reserved wares.
cues.reducedMotionAlternative: Static coin chip and quality frame, no glint pass.

cues.label: Warden's Steps forge heat
cues.ambientCopy: Armor fitting should read as practical progression: warm forge light, oath marks, and visible quality steps.
cues.vfxIntent: Brief temper sparks and quality-overlay glows on fitted armor slots.
cues.audioIntent: Soft hammer taps, cooling metal hiss, and a restrained upgrade confirmation tone.
cues.reducedMotionAlternative: One static quality badge per fitting and no spark scatter.
cues.uiProof: Map Warden's Steps and Gear drawer

cues.label: Bellroot Commons lamp still
cues.ambientCopy: The support district should feel soft and strange: alchemy warmth, Ilo's lamp readings, and recovery prep.
cues.vfxIntent: Gentle teal mote rings and potion-glass highlights for brews and readings.
cues.audioIntent: Glass clink, simmering herbs, and a quiet oracle chime for mystery clues.
cues.reducedMotionAlternative: Still teal mote icon and text-state changes instead of animated rings.
cues.uiProof: Map, Kit, and Journal Bellroot Commons rows
